Kit (Kit.com), San Francisco; physician-ordered at-home diagnostic test kits processed in its own CLIA-certified, CAP-accredited San Francisco lab. Founders Philip Fung (CEO) and Erik Salazar (COO). Acquired by Ro (Roman Health) on June 30, 2021 (Ro press release; price undisclosed). TechCrunch reported Kit had raised only a $3.3M seed round before the acquisition, from Expa, Sherpalo Ventures, South Park Commons, Slow Ventures and Village Global; caveat: TechCrunch attributed that figure to Crunchbase, and no lead or date for the seed was published. Domain from Ro's release (SPC page links none).
